title: How Doing the Boring Work First Builds the Man Everyone Trusts Later
caption:
Nobody claps for the work you do at 5 AM.

That's exactly the work God's watching.

Colossians 3:23 doesn't say work hard for the boss. It says work as for the Lord, not for men. One audience. Every task, big or small.

A man who can't finish the laundry can't be trusted with the team. Faithful in little isn't a footnote to faithful in much. It's the whole test.

Do the boring work. Let God do the building.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #work
